profile.headline: Software Developer at RateLinx
profile.summary:
Experienced IT professional with a strong background in software design, development and team management. 

Attention to detail, planning and execution are core to success. 

Truly enjoy collaborating and coordinating with end-users to define and implement a product that will work effectively and efficiently from both IT and User perspectives.

Professional Highlights

 18 years of experience developing client-server based applications on Windows platforms.
 Experience working in a Team and Project Leadership role at multiple organizations, with responsibilities including project planning, work assignments, team training, and communication with other teams as well as clients.
 Experience with internal customer and external customer end users, including application design, troubleshooting, training and on-site installation/training visits.
 Experience with multiple relational databases, including table design, primary and foreign keys, indexing. Also, experience creating complex database queries, stored procedures, functions and Common Table Expressions, as well as statement performance testing.

Project Highlights

 Served as Lead Developer on a Large Scale software conversion project from legacy FoxPro system to VB.NET applications with PostgreSQL database. 
 Served as Lead Developer for conversion of Warehouse software from an Access Database backend to a SQL Server backend. 
 Mentored and trained new developers in development best practices and procedures. 
 Created Form Standards and layouts for a multiple module software application, as well as multiple shared modules and classes used throughout the modules. 
 Created Windows Services to run automated background processes, including batch file processing, tariff calculations and automatic email generation 
 Acted as Scrum Master in an agile development environment.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
 Helped plan and implement conversion of DoD Transportation billing system from FoxPro to VB.NET WinForms based applications, while also prioritizing and implementing normal day-to-day development projects.
    o Created over 100 forms, modules and classes over 6 applications within the new WinForm applications, including objects specific to each module, and objects shared across multiple applications.
    o Created a DoD Tariff Rating process to perform calculations of charges based on government directive.
    o Created Windows Services to automatically perform specified tasks, including parsing .csv and .xml files into database tables, as well as generating reports for internal use, as well as reports send to customers via both Email and FTP.
    o Created reports using ActiveReports front end, against the PostgreSQL database.
    o Created tables using scripts within the PostgreSQL database, using relational database techniques including primary and foreign keys, constraints and database triggers.
    o Generated standalone SQL statements, functions and stored procedures to retrieve data for display in forms, reports and to be used in calculations and other processing.
 Daily communication with other Team Leads to help set priorities for the development team.
 Assisted in the hiring/interviewing process of new developers, and mentored new hires in the company’s development standards and best practices.
 Troubleshoot internal and external customer issues to provide timely resolutions, including direct communication with internal users as well as offsite customers through both email and telephone communication.
 Design and document new software specifications while working with requirements from other department Team Leads.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed applications used by the stores supplied by the Affiliated Foods Midwest warehouse.
•	Assisted with troubleshooting issues from member stores.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Helped plan, design, prioritize and implement new features for the company’s staffing software suite.
•	Worked with design and testing teams to make sure software met or exceeded customer specifications and functionality.
•	Visited customer locations to assist implementing software updates and assist in training end users.
